candidates.change_summary: Replace the assert checking overflow with an unchecked addition that omits the assert, allowing balances to wrap on overflow.
Change the addition to assign a constant (zero) instead of adding msg.value, so deposit does not increase balance.
Swap the order of the assert and the addition so the assert checks the pre-state against msg.value after balances has already been increased (which may fail), changing observable outcome.
Change addition to subtract msg.value, decreasing the balance when deposit is called.
Insert an early return so deposit is a no-op and balance is unchanged.
Swap the transfer and balance decrement so the contract updates balances only after sending funds (introduces potential reentrancy differing behavior).
Decrement the balance before transferring funds (original already does this order, but here we change to subtract an extra fixed 1 wei before transfer), causing different post-withdraw balances.
Transfer one wei less than requested while still deducting the full amount from the stored balance, causing divergence between state and funds actually sent.
Prevent transfer by sending zero and still decrementing balance, changing observable balance after withdraw.
Require strictly less than balance instead of less-or-equal, disallow withdrawing the full balance and thus change observable outcomes when amount == balance.
